hero.title: RNB Global University
hero.summary: RNB Global University’s School of Agriculture in Bikaner combines a four-year honours degree with crop-based practical work. Rural experience, an agro-industrial attachment and live projects feature in the school’s published pedagogy. Separate fee categories for Rajasthan and outside-state students make the applicant’s domicile an important cost-checking detail.

overview.heading: Agriculture study with rural and enterprise exposure
paragraphs: RNBGU’s agriculture school describes a curriculum that connects classroom subjects with farms and commercial activity. Its published pedagogy includes rural agricultural work experience, skill and entrepreneurship modules, and demonstrations involving crop production, nurseries and horticultural crops. The programme page lists a four-year bachelor’s degree.

The university was established under a Rajasthan act in 2015. Its agriculture course pages distinguish Rajasthan-domicile applicants from those outside the state. Applicants should therefore compare the correct category, tuition, examination fee and one-time enrolment charges. The university also publishes a dated 2026 scholarship policy, which specifies that awards apply to tuition and have academic continuation conditions.

programmes.name: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture
programmes.summary: An honours agriculture degree with rural work, industry exposure and production projects.
programmes.eligibility: Programme page states 10+2 PCM/PCB/Agriculture from a recognised board; obtain the intake-year marks requirement.
programmes.admission_route: The university procedure describes RNBGU Aptitude and Proficiency Test and application review; confirm agriculture-specific exemptions or accepted routes.

fees.includes: Outside-Rajasthan programme page: ₹45,000 tuition and ₹10,000 examination fee.
fees.note: The official 2026 schedule lists outside-Rajasthan tuition ₹45,000 plus examination ₹10,000 per semester; Rajasthan domicile tuition ₹35,000 plus examination ₹10,000, total ₹45,000. Non-refundable enrolment ₹10,000 is one time. Accommodation is separate.

scholarships.heading: Scholarships and financial support
scholarships.text: The 2026 policy includes agriculture within its undergraduate scholarship grouping. Awards are limited to tuition; attendance, grades, backlogs and conduct affect continuation.

schemes.name: Undergraduate merit scholarships, 2026
schemes.details: The official 2026 policy sets achievement-based categories for its agriculture grouping. Confirm the award and exam-validity conditions; examination and enrolment charges are excluded from scholarship coverage.

recognition.text: The audited ICAR register identifies RNB Global University, Bikaner with validity from 2025-05-16 to 2030-05-15. The programme labels below preserve the register’s scope; other institutional degrees are not covered by inference.

faculty.intro: The official faculty directory identifies an Agricultural Extension Education teacher. His role is reported as published in the directory checked on31October2026; no dated appointment order was established.

faqs.question: Where is RNBGU located?
faqs.answer: The university gives RNB Global City, Ganganagar Road, Bikaner, Rajasthan 334601.

faqs.question: How long is the agriculture honours programme?
faqs.answer: The course page lists four years.

faqs.question: Why does domicile matter when checking fees?
faqs.answer: The university publishes separate agriculture course pages for Rajasthan-domicile and outside-Rajasthan applicants.

faqs.question: What does the 2026 outside-Rajasthan agriculture fee include?
faqs.answer: The official schedule totals ₹55,000 per semester: ₹45,000 tuition and ₹10,000 examination fee. Non-refundable enrolment is ₹10,000 once; accommodation is separate.

faqs.question: Do scholarships reduce every charge?
faqs.answer: No. The 2026 policy restricts scholarship coverage to tuition and excludes charges such as examination, enrolment and accommodation.

faqs.question: Which ICAR term covers the listed degree?
faqs.answer: The audited B.Sc. Agriculture record runs from 16 May 2025 to 15 May 2030.
